# spelling-buddy

> A procedural 2.5D character rig for Canvas2D and SVG. No image assets and no
> runtime dependencies — the character, and the alphabet it writes, are
> geometry evaluated per frame.

Two audiences, two entry points. If you are an agent adding the character to a
page in a product, read AGENTS.md and stop there — it is the whole contract in
one screen, and the rest of this file is about building new things rather than
using the existing one.

## Using it in an app (start here)

- [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/yuvalsuede/spelling-buddy/blob/main/AGENTS.md): The contract. One import, one prop, six phases, and the four things not to do.
- [RECIPES.md](https://github.com/yuvalsuede/spelling-buddy/blob/main/RECIPES.md): Whole working components — a spelling test, a letter grid, a scored finger-trace pad. Copy one; do not assemble from fragments.
- [integrations/nextjs/Buddy.tsx](https://github.com/yuvalsuede/spelling-buddy/blob/main/integrations/nextjs/Buddy.tsx): The wrapper to copy into `src/components/buddy/`. Pages import from there and nowhere else.
- [scripts/check-usage.mjs](https://github.com/yuvalsuede/spelling-buddy/blob/main/scripts/check-usage.mjs): `node node_modules/spelling-buddy/scripts/check-usage.mjs src` — exits non-zero with `file:line` for every violation of AGENTS.md. Run it before claiming a page is done.

## The API

- [docs/01-getting-started.md](https://github.com/yuvalsuede/spelling-buddy/blob/main/docs/01-getting-started.md): Mounting, sizing, disposal.
- [docs/02-api.md](https://github.com/yuvalsuede/spelling-buddy/blob/main/docs/02-api.md): Every method, with what it returns and when it is a no-op.
- [docs/03-animations.md](https://github.com/yuvalsuede/spelling-buddy/blob/main/docs/03-animations.md): Expressions (states) versus actions (events), and how they compose.
- [docs/04-theming.md](https://github.com/yuvalsuede/spelling-buddy/blob/main/docs/04-theming.md): The twelve skins, what each slot means, and which colours the brand reserves.
- [docs/09-speech.md](https://github.com/yuvalsuede/spelling-buddy/blob/main/docs/09-speech.md): Visemes, cues, and driving the mouth from an external voice.
- [docs/10-tracing.md](https://github.com/yuvalsuede/spelling-buddy/blob/main/docs/10-tracing.md): Letter geometry, pen position, and scoring a learner's trace.
- [types/index.d.ts](https://github.com/yuvalsuede/spelling-buddy/blob/main/types/index.d.ts): The full typed surface. Authoritative when prose and types disagree.

## How it works

- [docs/07-architecture.md](https://github.com/yuvalsuede/spelling-buddy/blob/main/docs/07-architecture.md): The Surface abstraction, the 2.5D projection, and why Canvas and SVG cannot drift apart.
- [src/core/geometry.js](https://github.com/yuvalsuede/spelling-buddy/blob/main/src/core/geometry.js): The fifteen constants the whole character is built from, and the projection.
- [src/core/glyphs.js](https://github.com/yuvalsuede/spelling-buddy/blob/main/src/core/glyphs.js): A–Z, a–z, 0–9 as monoline strokes in the order and direction a hand writes them.
- [src/core/accessories.js](https://github.com/yuvalsuede/spelling-buddy/blob/main/src/core/accessories.js): Worn things, and the three rules that keep them worn as the head turns.
- [src/core/phases.js](https://github.com/yuvalsuede/spelling-buddy/blob/main/src/core/phases.js): The six phases, and why a lesson-level API exists on top of the rig-level one.

## Verifying a change

- [scripts/test.mjs](https://github.com/yuvalsuede/spelling-buddy/blob/main/scripts/test.mjs): Unit and determinism tests. `npm run test:unit`.
- [scripts/visual.mjs](https://github.com/yuvalsuede/spelling-buddy/blob/main/scripts/visual.mjs): Rendering invariants plus SVG snapshots. Every invariant encodes a bug that shipped, because "it renders without throwing" is not the same claim as "it looks right". `npm run test:visual`.
- [scripts/sweep.mjs](https://github.com/yuvalsuede/spelling-buddy/blob/main/scripts/sweep.mjs): Contact sheets — every accessory, every pairing, a full 360°, both pitch extremes, all twelve skins. Look at the output before calling anything visual finished. `npm run sweep`.

## Optional

- [examples/lesson.html](https://github.com/yuvalsuede/spelling-buddy/blob/main/examples/lesson.html): The whole loop in about 180 lines, no build step.
- [docs/06-export.md](https://github.com/yuvalsuede/spelling-buddy/blob/main/docs/06-export.md): Deterministic SVG, PNG, sprite sheet, GIF and WebM export.
- [docs/08-troubleshooting.md](https://github.com/yuvalsuede/spelling-buddy/blob/main/docs/08-troubleshooting.md): Blank canvas, doubled characters, blurry output, SSR.
